auth.format: Authorization: Bearer <key> (raw key without Bearer prefix also accepted; package sends Bearer)
auth.scopes: none - key grants full access of the creating user
auth.expiry: optional expiresAt per key, may be null (non-expiring)

meta.sourceVerifiedNotes: Query params marked source:true are implemented by the handler at the pinned commit but absent from the swagger annotations.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.note: archived entities are EXCLUDED by default

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.note: createdAt/updatedAt sort DESC, name/assetId ASC; default name

parameters.name: isLocation
parameters.note: true = locations only, false/absent = items only

parameters.name: filterChildren
parameters.note: with parentIds: direct children only vs whole subtree

operations.summary: Get the full path of an entity
